section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1981
title: 26 ## Causes of Suicides The total number of Suicide cases reported during 1981 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'Other Causes' covers the unspecified causes of Suicides sharing 50·1 percent of the total suicides. Among the important causes of suicides 'Dreadful Diseases' was the major causes of suicides during 1981 which accounted for 14·2 percent of total suicides. The second important causes of suicides was 'Quarrel with parents-in-law' (8·2%) followed by 'Quarrel with spouse' (6·8%) 'Love Affairs' (5·5%), 'Insanity' (3·6%), 'Dispute over Property' (3·2%), 'Poverty' (2·9%), 'Failure in Examination' (2·1%), 'Unemployment (1·1%), 'Fall in Social Reputation' (1·0%), 'Bankruptcy or sudden change in Economic Position' (0·7%), and 'Deaths of Dear Persons' (0·6%), The detailed statistics are presented in Table-III.
